edition: CISC Structural Section Tables (SST) 9.2 - W shapes
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). Values not printed by the source are computed exactly from the published dimensions and listed per shape in 'computed'.

sources.CISC-SST9.2: CISC Structural Section Tables v9.2, W shapes as transcribed in rpakishore/steelsections-cisc @929bf04 (Apache-2.0), src/cisc_sections/data/cisc_9.2/W.csv

conventions: local 3 = major axis, 2 = minor; d along local 2.  As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf.  x0 = y0 = 0 (doubly symmetric). dims.r (root radius, listed in computed_dims) is taken from the identical ASTM A6 shape of aisc.json (AISC v16 kdes - tf).
